key_insight: Conformal-DRO builds a finite-sample ambiguity set for latent outcome laws using nested conformal regions, giving a robust decision guarantee without modeling the hidden heterogeneity mechanism.
engineering_relevance: This offers a practical way to make high-stakes optimization decisions safer under unobserved distribution shift, with a certificate on the expected cost of the chosen action.
method: Uses exchangeability and nested conformal sets to cover the future latent law with probability at least 1-α.
Turns the conformal path into a transport-like geometry that defines the ambiguity radius via α.
Solves the robust worst-case objective as a finite linear program with sparse adversarial solutions.
evidence_signal: The abstract claims a finite-sample coverage guarantee of at least 1-α for the latent law, yielding a certificate for the decision’s expected cost.
watch_item: The guarantee relies on exchangeability and conformal calibration, so performance may degrade if the data are not representative of future latent instances.
paper_title: Conformal-DRO: Distributionally Robust Optimization with Conformalized Ambiguity Set
